instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Specialty chemicals formulator producing high-performance industrial adhesives, sealants, and surface treatment solutions specifically tailored for the demanding automotive repair aftermarket. Synapse Partners maintains an in-house R&D lab with three highly skilled chemists focused on material science innovation. While operations are stable, the company is actively seeking to transition from traditional batch processing to more agile, data-driven manufacturing models.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. This project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams, demonstrating the value of integrated digital solutions. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this optimized flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior in automotive maintenance. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business; we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand's chemical expertise, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing, not shrinking.
answers.additionalContext: We underwent a significant restructuring 6 months ago, consolidating five business units into three and reducing headcount by 12%. The remaining teams are stretched thin managing the same workload with fewer people. Morale has stabilized but is still recovering. Any innovation initiative must be achievable without adding burden to already-overloaded teams and should visibly improve their daily work experience.
answers.teamSize: We have a dedicated innovation squad of 8 people — 4 engineers, 1 data scientist, 1 UX designer, 1 product manager, and a part-time business analyst. This team operates with its own sprint cadence separate from the core product teams and has an allocated annual innovation budget. They report progress quarterly to the executive committee.

opportunities.title: Supply Chain Optimization via Predictive Analytics
opportunities.rationale: Given the high competitive pressure and tight budget, optimizing current material logistics for cost reduction is a low-risk starting point. This radical change can immediately improve margins and operational efficiency.

first_actions: Conduct a process mapping exercise of the top 5 raw materials' supply chain.
Pilot a lightweight predictive maintenance algorithm for key production machinery.
execution_plan.success_metric: 10% reduction in raw material waste and logistics costs within 6 months.
milestones: Q2: Define scope and resource allocation.
Q3: Implement pilot program and measure initial savings.

opportunities.title: Adjacent Market Entry: Sustainable Specialty Coatings
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the core chemical expertise to diversify into high-growth, lower-risk adjacent markets like sustainable industrial coatings. This is a radical move that uses existing IP and allows Synapse to bypass direct competition in saturated automotive repair.

first_actions: Identify three non-automotive B2B sectors with high demand for eco-friendly adhesives (e.g., renewable energy infrastructure).
Develop a minimal viable product (MVP) focused on water-based, low-VOC sealants.
execution_plan.success_metric: Securing one pilot contract in a new B2B sector within 1 year.
milestones: Q3: Feasibility study and IP review for target market.
Q4: Launch of MVP and initial sales pipeline generation.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Formulation Discovery Platform
opportunities.rationale: To address the 'partial' innovation process and talent gaps, investing in a radical platform that uses AI to rapidly screen chemical formulations could dramatically accelerate R&D cycles. This directly tackles the bottleneck of slow batch recipe management.

first_actions: Evaluate three leading cheminformatics software solutions.
Establish a dedicated data pipeline for historical R&D results.
resources_needed: High capital expenditure for platform licensing ($150k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in time-to-new formulation by 40% through AI screening.
milestones: Q2: Platform selection and proof of concept setup.
Q4: Full integration into the R&D workflow.

next_steps.action: Formalize a 'Strategic Pivot' charter focusing solely on non-automotive diversification targets.
Conduct an immediate talent gap analysis to prioritize hiring for AI/Data Science skills over traditional chemical engineering roles.

key_weaknesses: Inconsistent innovation process execution across business units
Over-reliance on legacy automotive aftermarket demand, leading to structural risk
Significant talent shortage in data science and advanced computational chemistry
Budget constraints limiting the scope of radical diversification attempts
